faqs.question: What is Azure Logic Apps?
faqs.answer: Azure Logic Apps is a cloud-based service that enables you to automate workflows and integrate apps, data, and services across organizations.

faqs.question: Do I need coding skills to use Azure Logic Apps?
faqs.answer: No, Azure Logic Apps offers a visual designer that allows you to build workflows without writing code.

faqs.question: Can Azure Logic Apps connect to on-premises systems?
faqs.answer: Yes, using the on-premises data gateway, Azure Logic Apps can securely connect to on-premises data and systems.
